# Iowa Trust Motors

> Used car dealership in Johnston, Iowa. Inspected pre-owned cars, trucks and SUVs with transparent pricing and online financing. Vehicles are sold AS-IS with no dealer warranty.

- Email: sales@iowatrustmotors.com
- Business hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 5pm
